company.name: ProblemCo Holdings Inc. (illustrative, modeled on Hertz FY2020)

summaries.title: Business
summaries.summary: Item 1. Business ProblemCo Holdings Inc. operates a global vehicle rental business through a network of company-operated and franchised locations in North America, Europe and other international markets. The Company rents cars, crossovers and light trucks under several brand names and also sells used vehicles through its retail sales channels.

summaries.title: Risk Factors
summaries.summary: Item 1A. Risk Factors The Chapter 11 Cases raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern. Our recurring losses from operations, the material decline in travel demand resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic and the ongoing Chapter 11 Cases raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern. On May 22, 2020, the Company and certain of its subsidiaries filed voluntary petitions for relief under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code in the United States Bankruptcy Court.

summaries.title: Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A)
summaries.summary: Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations Total revenues for the year ended December 31, 2020 were $5,258 million, a decrease of 46% compared to 2019, reflecting the unprecedented decline in travel demand caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. The Company recorded a net loss of $1,714 million for the year. The commencement of the Chapter 11 Cases constituted an event of default under a number of instruments and agreements relating to the direct financial obligations of the Company.
